title: That Time
paragraphs: But… that day’s wave was something else.
“Well, things are about to get really busy.”
“Is Naofumi-san going to be the first one to have a wife and kids…?”
“I’d love to have a grand wedding. Let’s go all out. Next would be Itsuki, I guess?”

Itsuki seems to be getting along well with the stalker pig who’s already recovered. Itsuki was also surprised by the remarkable progress of the stalker pig, who had always had latent potential. It seems that the one-on-one training on mastering Energy Boost paid off. According to Itsuki, her aptitude for Energy Boost is abnormal.
“Y-Yes, I should start considering marriage with Rishia-san.”
“On the other hand, Ren doesn’t seem to be anywhere near that stage.”
“Hmph! I’m just not letting love affairs distract me like you guys!”
Haha, it’s been a while since I’ve seen Ren in such a bad mood.
“Motoyasu-kun, you still haven’t found Filo-chan… What about Yuki-chan’s feelings?”
“My heart belongs to Filo-tan, and Yuki-chan is like a daughter to me.”
“I won’t give up!”
“Wow, Yuki-chan isn’t backing down either. But anyway, it’s almost time.”
“Indeed!”
“Alright, let’s get through today’s wave and keep fighting until the world is at peace!”
With Father’s command, the soldiers and the filolials responded, and the time for the wave had come. But when the wave started and we were transferred to the location…
Suddenly, numbers appeared in my field of vision.
This sensation… I remember it!
“What!? One hour and thirty minutes!? What’s with this time limit!?”
In previous waves, we were able to finish them immediately after they started.
But I remember this! A figure appeared from the crack in the wave.
“An enemy!?”
“A person!?”
Father and the others raised voices of surprise at the sight of the figure.
“It looks like they’re fighting with the enemy beyond the wave’s crack.”
“If I recall the memories from the first world, allies should be fighting the enemies!”
“Allies!?”
“That’s what Father and his companions from the first world said.”
“Isn’t this another new revelation!?”
“But isn’t this good news?”
However, the numbers in my vision were decreasing at an incredible rate.
Wasn’t it supposed to be one hour and thirty minutes?
“So this is the updated world.”
“Let’s get started already.”
“Yeah, I know.”
The group in the back was trying to force the crack in the wave open even further with their hands.
“Like hell we’ll let you do that! Everyone, let’s go!”
At Ren’s call, we all responded and dashed forward.
With Father’s support, we’re unstoppable!
“The new power granted by the goddess is totally a cheat!”
“That’s such an annoying line!”
“Cheat? Don’t be ridiculous! It looks like they’re subordinates of that impostor claiming to be a god. Probably reincarnators.”
“Then there’s no time to hold back!”
“This time, I won’t lose! Brionac X! Followed by Aiming Lancer X!”
I unleashed a preemptive strike at those bastards.
Get vaporized by my most powerful, fully enhanced attack!
“Oh?”
The reincarnator I had seen before raised his hand. My skill was blocked by a wall.
“Hurry up. Even if it’s an Absolute Barrier, it won’t hold forever.”
“They took Motoyasu-kun’s skill without a scratch!?”
“A restricted Absolute Barrier!? It’s an ability that exists in my world as well.”
“What kind of ability is that!?”
“Don’t you understand? It generates an indestructible barrier. As long as it’s active, no attack can pass through.”
“Damn… even after all the strengthening we’ve gone through, our attacks still can’t get through!?”
This is absurd!
We’ve been through countless waves, fought all kinds of enemies, and our attacks always worked—so why aren’t they effective now!?
“The only drawback is that they can’t attack either. In my world, this is one of the highest-tier abilities. The strongest version can be maintained indefinitely.”
“Damn…”
“However… I’ve heard that continuous attacks can wear it down! Let’s get in close and break through!”
“Understood! Let’s go!”
We quickly charged at the enemy.
This is an all-out assault with the force of an entire army! Let’s see if they can withstand this!
“Bubububububububu!”
The pigs around the reincarnators started squealing.
They’re noisy—just die already!

The remaining time keeps ticking away! We have to take them down quickly! My hazy memories started to resurface. **“Meteor Lance X!”** To pierce through the enemy’s barrier, I unleashed my Meteor Lance. Like a shooting star, it flew toward the enemy’s barrier. But the lance’s trajectory was unable to pierce the wall. **“Meteor Sword X!”** Ren also unleashed his skill. A slightly different-looking meteor flew forth. Ren’s Meteor Sword had become an ultimate blade capable of cutting through anything by now.
But even that couldn’t break through! **“Full Buster X!”** Itsuki took aim and fired a laser of light that rivaled my Brionac.
Will this do the trick!?
“Ugh…”
“Just a little more! We’re almost through! Don’t stop attacking!”
“Understood!”
Everyone used their ultimate attacks and magic to continue attacking the enemy’s barrier.
“Tch, as much as it pisses me off, I can’t leave this entirely to you!”
When one of the reincarnators, seemingly an ally of the enemy, raised his hand in front of the barrier, our attacks were diverted to the side.
“Ugh… that was close.”
“Those attacks seem pretty heavy. No, they’re ridiculously powerful. But if they don’t hit me, they’re no threat.”
Annoying as ever! I will definitely take them down!
“Why are you trying to expand the wave!?”
“That’s right! What’s your objective!?”
Ren and Itsuki questioned the enemy.
“Isn’t it obvious? To guide the world on the right path. It’s basically like an update.”
“An update!?”
“You’re treating this like a game!?”
At this moment, my memories linked with the first world.
Yes… I remember this.
“That’s right. We fought these guys in the first world. Even with the support of Father, Ren, Itsuki, the holders of the Seven Star Weapons, and various reinforcements, we couldn’t stop them.”
“Don’t tell me… Motoyasu-kun, you were defeated!?”
“I don’t think that’s how it went.”
Yes, that’s right. If I remember correctly… after the remaining time ran out and the wave messed up the world… my memories after that are still hazy.
“The enemy that appears after this… that’s who I lost to! This is just the prelude. We have to end this wave quickly!”
“Shield Prison X!”

As expected, Father tried to use his wits to push the enemy back, but their numbers were overwhelming, and we were gradually being pushed back. To make matters worse, these enemies were managing to keep up with us, even after all the enhancements we’ve undergone.
“I see!”
Ren approached the enemy’s barrier, getting dangerously close… I remember this movement too.
“Float Sword!”
He summoned swords and made them rampage inside the enemy’s barrier.
“Like that’ll work!”
The enemy caught the swords, and they clashed in a deadlock.

Damn… without the holders of the Seven Star Weapons, it feels like we’re being pushed back more than in the first world. If I recall correctly, the one with the scythe weapon reacted to Father’s attack with a skill-like move back then, but there’s no sign of that happening now. However, thanks to our enhanced attacks, we managed to break the barrier. Last time, the time left was around **00:18**, but now it’s still **00:35**.
“Alright! Everyone, press the attack!”
“Whoa there, don’t forget about me!”
From the deepest part of the fissure, another enemy appeared, creating multiple layers of barriers in different colors.
And what’s this?
Papers are floating in the air, obstructing us!
“Damn it! Move!”
Ren, Itsuki, and Father slashed through the barriers alongside me. This time, the barrier was weaker than the previous one.
Unlike back then, I’m much stronger now—breaking through was easy!
“Don’t get in my way! If I clear this mission, I’ll be granted new power!”
“Granted?”
“What, you don’t know? The ability to summon an ultimate skill gets unlocked.”
This sounds familiar, but I don’t know anything about it! Such things are unnecessary!
